title: SWITCH on the COUNTROWS of an empty table does not match 0
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", SWITCH ( COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( T, FALSE ) ), 0, "zero", 1, "one", "other" ) )

source.quote: SWITCH ( COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( Query1, False ) ), 0, "zero", 1, "one", "other" ) other
source.supports: the article's example, on a table named Query1

derivation: FILTER ( T, FALSE ) is empty, so COUNTROWS is BLANK. SWITCH does not match BLANK with 0 or 1, so the else value "other" is returned.
